title: Last night was odd. Anyone else?
content: I just woke up. 6:54 am for me, and I won't share the exact premise just to get a feeling of it this was an odd dream or an actual phenomenon others experiences. Im interested to know what others have experienced last night if we're on the same sleep schedule: The details are: -people attempting to fight waking up bc something bad is happening and the mall world/dream world needs help -REAL people, who told me they aren't dream world citizens, and i explicitly remember two faces -people, Dream and real citizens alike, seeking my help, asking me not to wake up -one by one my family members all appeared and were very confused about what was going on. A blonde woman, who didn't tell me her name on purpose, said that no one would remember this morning except those 'like us'. She was begging me to stay asleep and help her. -my 'energy' was far more powerful than usual -I felt pain, actual pain, when I did my pinch test, and the sensations I do usually feel but this time it was as if I was ACTUALLY awake. Last night/this morning was vivid to a frightening degree and people begged me to stay asleep to help them because something bad was happening. Promise this isn't a schizo post lol. I've always been one to study dreams, lucid dream, etc. but last night/this morning was different. I forced myself awake because I was getting overwhelmed so I actually got to turn off my alarm. Does this make sense? I'm not one to believe in conspiracy theories or anything like that, nor have I ever dabbled in astral projection. Last night felt different. Just wondering if anyone had weird experiences last night or if I had a totally normal dream lol. Could be either or. Like I said I also JUST woke up so the after effects of it all still feels vivid and real. I'm sure after coffee I'll recount it all and laught it off as a silly usual dream.
